criterion_a.assessment: At the first unmatched return in each attempt there is no lifecycle/class-prepare evidence explaining a missed entry by disabled request, class redefinition/reload or thread-filter mismatch. Entry request 24 and return request 25 are recorded enabled with null thread filters; nearby method-exit request transitions concern different request identities/threads and do not satisfy criterion (a).

criterion_b.assessment: The active phase at every unmatched return is application-worker-started, not a specific application operation. Attempt 1 first stops at 1810 entries, attempt 2 first unmatched at 1614 and cap-stop at 1836; no operation near 12400 is reproduced in both attempts.

finding.finding: The earlier approximately 12400-generation point did not reproduce. Attempt 1 recorded 1810 entries before its first unmatched return, a shift of approximately 10590 fewer. Attempt 2 first unmatched occurred at 1614, with 1836 at cap-stop. This is recorded as a finding, not a causal explanation.

test_limitations.cleanup_attribution: No evidence establishes a pass on October 11-12 for any of these 27 followed solely by loss in the October 13 07:19 cleanup. Older development summaries report some successful retained-evidence tests on earlier code; these are not exact-62eafdaf rerun evidence. Some host-integration paths still exist, so wholesale loss is not inferred.
test_limitations.failure_scope: No FAIL or ERROR result for these 27 was found in the two inspected 62eafdaf CI logs. This does not prove they never failed in older development.
